# every Call of Gmpf.java is a row and every row a Call) and mirrored in devices/g0111/image/verify_tree_x50.py MENU_APP.
# Codes: found BY METHOD NAME in devices/g0111/research/aidl_codes.tsv (X50 hash 715affd0...), never copied from the Z9X
# (test/run.sh checks every row against that table; all of them also have the same code on the HB table, which is why
# the HB's banned.tsv applies). Stock evidence: the X50 stock apps decompiled on xgimi-builder
# the design notes. t12 adds the stock eye-protection switch / mode (61, 126: user rows only,
# newsettings MoreRepository / MoreViewModel), projection mode (2 / 3 + MotionDetection 8, SystemManager 140), the
# four-corner keystone (15 / 16 / 64), picture items (GmTvManager 5..12, the XgimiService MtkVideo path) and sound mode
# (GmAudioManager 6 / 7). NOT here on purpose: 101 (setHumanDetectOnOffEx, not the newsettings path), 66 (vendor eye
# cover), 99 / 100 (heartbeat), laser current and ambient light getters (README.md says why); autoFocus 3,
# correctKeystone 11 and setTiltShiftMove 88 (BANNED) only since t20, see below. t14 adds
# the level angles (MotionDetectionManager 25 getMotionAttitude, newsettings AngleMonitorDialog) with that dialog's own
# calls around them (maintainer OK 2026-11-08: setMotionACalEnable 24 heartbeat, temporarySwitchTrigger(2, z) 15 move-AK
# pause), and the picture page of the design notes: picture mode 33 / 34 (the X50 settings tree list),
# dynamic black 172 / 174, dynamic contrast 113 / 114. Still NOT here: contrast enhancement 166 / 167 (t15: the X50
# settings tree has no such node, so the stock X50 menu never shows it), the dynamic black
# level 173 / 175 (X50 dynamicBlack.ini force_level = 1, the stock switch never writes it), setDynamicBlackTypeEx 184 (no
# stock caller), AI contrast 156-159, HDR 174-175 / 133-135, light source / lumens (4-7, 177 / 178, Xlab factory path).
# (MotionDetectionManager 5) removed: the X50 tree focus_tab has only smart_auto_focus (85 + MotionDetectionManager 4
# together), so a power-on AF or a separate 'AF when moved' switch would write vendor-store states stock never shows.
# t18 (owner OK 2026-11-09): the projection Auto radio: MotionDetectionManager 8 now also sends true
# (only from Sequences.autoTurn, the Auto choice) and its getter 9 getAutoReverse is read; 68 rows.
